speaking.title: About yourself
speaking.prompt: Tell us a little about yourself. What would you like us to know about you?
speaking.referenceAnswer: I am a friendly person who enjoys learning. I like meeting people and improving my English.

speaking.title: Your hobbies
speaking.prompt: What do you enjoy doing in your free time? Why do you enjoy it?
speaking.referenceAnswer: I enjoy reading short stories and walking. Reading helps me learn new words, and walking helps me relax.

speaking.title: Your daily routine
speaking.prompt: Describe a normal day in your life, from morning to evening.
speaking.referenceAnswer: I wake up early and have breakfast. During the day I study or work. In the evening I relax and prepare for tomorrow.

speaking.title: Your favorite food
speaking.prompt: What is your favorite food? Describe it and say when you like to eat it.
speaking.referenceAnswer: I like rice with vegetables because it is simple and tasty. I often eat it for lunch with my family.

speaking.title: Your hometown
speaking.prompt: Tell us about the town or city where you live. What do you like about it?
speaking.referenceAnswer: My town has shops, schools, and a park. I like the park because it is a quiet place to walk.

speaking.title: A good friend
speaking.prompt: What qualities do you like in a friend? Give an example.
speaking.referenceAnswer: I like friends who are kind and honest. A good friend listens when I have a problem and helps when possible.

speaking.title: Your weekend
speaking.prompt: How do you usually spend your weekend? What would you like to do next weekend?
speaking.referenceAnswer: I usually rest and spend time with friends. Next weekend I would like to visit a park and have lunch outside.

speaking.title: A place to visit
speaking.prompt: Where would you like to visit? Explain why you chose that place.
speaking.referenceAnswer: I would like to visit a place near the mountains. I enjoy fresh air and would like to see the beautiful views.

speaking.title: Learning English
speaking.prompt: Why do you want to improve your English? How do you practice?
speaking.referenceAnswer: I want to speak more confidently with other people. I practice by listening to short stories and speaking a little every day.

speaking.title: Your favorite season
speaking.prompt: Which season do you like best? What do you do during that season?
speaking.referenceAnswer: I like spring because the weather is pleasant. I enjoy walking outside and seeing flowers in the park.

speaking.title: A useful skill
speaking.prompt: What is one simple skill you would like to learn? How would you start?
speaking.referenceAnswer: I would like to learn to cook. I would begin with an easy recipe and ask someone to show me the steps.

speaking.title: A happy memory
speaking.prompt: Describe a happy day you remember. What made it special?
speaking.referenceAnswer: I remember a picnic with my friends. We shared food and played games. It was special because we had time to enjoy being together.

speaking.title: Your favorite sport
speaking.prompt: Do you enjoy playing or watching a sport? Explain your answer.
speaking.referenceAnswer: I like playing cricket with friends. It is fun and helps me stay active. I also enjoy working together as a team.

speaking.title: Books or films
speaking.prompt: Do you prefer reading books or watching films? Tell us why.
speaking.referenceAnswer: I prefer films because I enjoy seeing the characters and places. I sometimes watch with subtitles to learn new English words.

speaking.title: A person you admire
speaking.prompt: Describe someone you admire and explain what you like about them.
speaking.referenceAnswer: I admire a teacher who was always patient. They explained things clearly and encouraged everyone to keep trying.

speaking.title: Your morning
speaking.prompt: What do you do after waking up? Describe the steps in order.
speaking.referenceAnswer: First I wash and get dressed. Then I have breakfast and check my plans. After that I get ready to leave home.

speaking.title: Helping someone
speaking.prompt: Tell us about a time you helped someone, or describe how you would help a new classmate.
speaking.referenceAnswer: I would introduce myself and show a new classmate around. I would help them find the classroom and answer their questions.

speaking.title: Your goals
speaking.prompt: What is one goal you have for the next year? What can you do to reach it?
speaking.referenceAnswer: I want to speak English more clearly. I plan to practice every day and ask for feedback so I can improve.

speaking.title: Your favorite place
speaking.prompt: Describe a place where you feel comfortable. What do you like about it?
speaking.referenceAnswer: I like a quiet corner at home where I can read. It has good light and a comfortable chair.

speaking.title: Trying something new
speaking.prompt: What new activity would you like to try? Why does it interest you?
speaking.referenceAnswer: I would like to try gardening. I enjoy being outside and would like to learn how to grow flowers.

listening.title: A morning walk
listening.text: I like to walk in the park before breakfast. The park is near my house. I usually go with my friend. After our walk, we return home and get ready for the day.

listening.title: A new student
listening.text: My name is Sara. I am learning English at a small school. My classes start in the morning. I bring a notebook and a pen. After class, I practice new words with a friend.

listening.title: Weekend plans
listening.text: On Saturday, we plan to visit the library. My brother wants a book about animals. I would like a short story. After choosing our books, we will have lunch at home.

listening.title: Making breakfast
listening.text: Every morning, I make a cup of tea and prepare breakfast. I like bread and eggs. Before leaving the kitchen, I wash my cup and put the dishes away. Then I check my plans.

listening.title: A birthday visit
listening.text: Today is my friend's birthday. I will visit her in the evening. I have a small gift and a card. We will share some food and talk about our favorite memories.

listening.title: At the shop
listening.text: Please buy some milk and bread from the shop. The shop is next to the bus stop. Take a bag with you. When you come home, put the milk in the kitchen.

listening.title: A rainy day
listening.text: It is raining this afternoon, so we will stay inside. I will read a book, and my sister will draw a picture. Later, we will make tea and watch a film together.

listening.title: A favorite hobby
listening.text: My favorite hobby is drawing. I keep my pencils in a small box. I like drawing trees and flowers. Sometimes I show my pictures to my friends and ask which one they like.

listening.title: An evening routine
listening.text: After dinner, I usually clean the table and help in the kitchen. Then I spend some time reading. Before bed, I prepare my clothes for the next day and set my alarm.

listening.title: A family picnic
listening.text: We are going to the park for a picnic. Please bring some water and a blanket. I will pack the sandwiches. We can sit under a tree and enjoy the warm weather.

listening.title: Learning a skill
listening.text: I want to learn how to cook a simple meal. My friend will show me the steps this weekend. First, we will buy the food we need. Then we will prepare everything in the kitchen.

listening.title: A bus journey
listening.text: The bus stop is a short walk from my home. I leave early so I do not have to hurry. I carry my bag and wait in line. On the bus, I like to sit near the window.

listening.title: A quiet library
listening.text: The library is a quiet place to read and study. Please speak softly and keep your phone silent. You can ask for help at the front desk. Return your books before you leave.

listening.title: Meeting a friend
listening.text: I am meeting my friend at the cafe after lunch. We will sit near the window. I want to hear about her new class. If I am late, I will call and let her know.

listening.title: Preparing for tomorrow
listening.text: Before going to sleep, I write a short list for tomorrow. I put my notebook in my bag and check the weather. If rain is expected, I leave an umbrella near the door.
